name: Clipboard History
description: Manage and access your clipboard history

walkthrough.title: Never lose what you copied again
walkthrough.summary: Open clipboard history on three separate days
walkthrough.body:
Everything you copy is kept, searchable, and one keystroke away. No more copying something and losing what was there before, no more re-finding the same link twice.

Clipboard history is the single feature people say changed how they work — but only after it has caught them a few times. That is why this task asks for three days rather than one visit.

## To complete the task

1. Copy a few things as you normally would.
2. Open **Clipboard History** and paste something from further back.
3. Do it again on three separate days.
